name: Issue 3193: Convergence adds its Elemental damage to the next 10 Weapon Engravings
contract: Convergence 801086 reads 'For $d, the next 10 Weapon Engravings you trigger will now deal an additional
${$560241m1*$<scalingbp>+$SP*0.3+$AP*0.2} Elemental Damage.' Effect 0 is aura 42 triggering 560241 (Fire, Frost
and Arcane school damage), ProcChance 100, ProcCharges 0 and DBC ProcFlags 0; there is no spell_proc row, so
the aura never procs. Every Weapon Engraving effect spell (Fire 653210, Water 653261, Ice 653217, Arcane 653263,
Earth 653272, Air 653226) carries family 38 mask0 0x20000. Earth Engraving 653219 is applied as a fixture aura
and Earthen Fists 806982 at 5 stacks raises its proc to 65% (runemaster-earth-engraving.json). Expected: cast
Convergence holds 10 charges, and an engraving that hits the target triggers 560241 on that target (about 10
swings in 14 sec, so no Earth proc has probability 0.35^10 < 3e-5).
